verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents each step of the story as a first-party capability. Agent Checkouts let an agent buy from any merchant URL under a spending cap, and a checkout run is polled until it reaches a terminal state. Agent Cards issue scoped, merchant-locked order intents that mint one-time card credentials via Visa Intelligent Commerce or Mastercard Agent Pay, so the agent never sees the real card number. The order-confirmation step is thinly described, and all evidence is vendor docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detailed order-confirmation and receipt documentation, webhooks for agent checkouts (v1 is poll-only), a staging/test environment (production-only), and broader card eligibility (Visa excludes non-US, business, prepaid, Chase and Fidelity cards).
